title: BTA! Cloud Layers
description: Adds adjustable layers to the clouds.
body:
BTA! Cloud Layers does what it says on the tin, it's a simple client-side mod that adds multiple adjustable layers to the clouds.
![An image showcasing how the clouds look with the mod's default settings.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd09465db74904f1639f9bbaed1e8ac85e9a5370.png)

You can find a new page in the options menu to make adjustments to the layers.![An image showcasing the new options page for adjusting cloud layers.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/648d6ee53bcd9eaef3f836caf9dfa7ed6347f5b9.png)
